horoscope: The day can feel quite balanced, dear Aries, and you readily get in the right frame of mind for sharing or learning. Your interests lie not only in expanding and growing something important to you, but also in how best to do it. The need for a change of pace can dominate, but you’re also ready to take things slowly but surely. It’s easier to be objective about a matter that was once quite confusing. Clarity comes naturally today. You might enjoy valuable feedback from others, and making some subtle but helpful improvements can be in the spotlight. Conversations with a partner or special friend can be fair and productive.

Today's transits are good for emotional strength and centering yourself, dear Taurus. The Moon spends the day in your solar eighth house of intimacy, and your need to observe and reflect is stronger than usual. You’re processing your feelings and recent events. Rather than pushing forward with new activities, you’re inclined to take time for self-discovery. The day feels balanced and orderly, and it's just what you need at the moment. You're more interested in the "why" and "how" of situations, people, and your inner workings. You may be a little less patient with frivolous matters or superficialities of interaction. Deeper, hidden subjects and topics come to the surface.

Impressions are especially strong through your emotions today, dear Gemini. Still, with today's Moon, you tend to absorb a lot from others, as you tune in more intuitively to the needs and feelings of the people close to you. You might enjoy communications that please you and make you feel hopeful for the future. Today favors a mature, forthright approach in your dealings. The urge to soak up ideas and inspiration from others is strong, and good opportunities seem to emerge to do so. Whether it’s through the encouragement of a significant person in your life or a relationship goal that is motivating you now, it’s a fine time to nurture your ambition and get things done. You seek emotional understanding and true equality.

With the Moon in your work and health sector today, dear Cancer, you may want to help or be of service to others with practical tasks. It’s a time when you thoroughly enjoy piecing things together. Quiet or solitary activities suit you just fine, and in fact, tend to bring out your best today. It’s also a good time for handling the details that will further your financial or work goals. A pleasant emphasis on building up your resources is possible now, and you’re finding it easy and natural to tap into your talents. Today's transits especially support efforts to refine and perfect projects and programs related to your daily life, work, and self-care. You may have good conversations or ideas about how to improve these things.

The Moon spends today in your creative sector, dear Leo, encouraging you to share your happy feelings. Still, working on longer-term projects that don’t pay off immediately, whether materially or spiritually, makes sense now. You’re inclined to make the most of your leisure time. Good advice may be circulating, and you may be contributing to this! It's a potentially strong day for connecting with others and for creative ideas. You may find your motivation rising, and you're becoming more and more enthused about what you're doing and where you're headed. This, in turn, can attract some positive attention, and partnerships can improve as well.

Today's transits excel for building emotional strength and self-esteem, dear Virgo. The Moon spends the day in your home and family sector, and you crave more consistency. You seem to need more comfort, familiarity, and quiet at this time of the lunar month. It might help to dial things down and enjoy yourself, and you can think of it as a form of regeneration. There can be a nice focus on attention to your personal needs, family, or home life. You seem to need the time and space to get yourself together. You're taking a more objective look at your personal life or past today, gaining insights into how to improve your base of operations or support structure.

Today's transits keep you pleasantly busy with the Moon in your solar third house, dear Libra. You’re motivated by your curiosity. It's also a fine time for accomplishing something, however big or small, as you’re in a practical frame of mind and quite content to go about your business in an orderly fashion. Even so, it can also be a time of an inspirational awakening or change. Something can jumpstart your own thinking, and sharing your expertise or lending a hand can be rewarding. There can be a pleasant focus on learning and connecting. The pieces of a puzzle come together on a mental level today.

The Moon spends the day in your resources sector, dear Scorpio, and making or building something useful holds appeal. You have pleasing energy with you for making progress on a project or business endeavor. You might enjoy a good buy with the Moon in your money sector forming harmonious aspects. Getting a handle on practical matters seems more intuitive and natural today. The desire for a little more control in your life is motivating now, and the need for tangible results strengthens your self-discipline. As well, learning new things about your inner needs can be satisfying.

The Moon continues to move through your sign today, dear Sagittarius, connecting well with planets, and you’re comfortable in your skin. While you prefer to play things by ear with this transit, you're more disciplined than usual. Your need to feel connected or acknowledged is strong. This is a good day for seeing opportunities all around you, but also for putting in the work. You acknowledge feelings that you’ve recently pushed to the side, and emotions are sharp and clear. You can use your unique perception and creativity in useful ways today.

The Moon spends the day in your privacy sector, dear Capricorn, and you benefit from pausing your busy schedule or taking an emotional vacation. You may feel in real need of calm. There can be a signal from the cosmos to take things easy (or easier) so that you can catch your breath and process recent events. Your interest may lie in bettering yourself through self-understanding. Time alone or time to unwind can be especially helpful. Reflection can bring new insight into your emotions and the past. At the same time, thinking is smart today, and you see options where there didn't seem to be any in the past, particularly related to your larger goals, career, and money matters.

With the Moon in your solar eleventh house all day, dear Aquarius, your emotional focus can be on friends, a cause, or a long-term plan. There can be a nice feeling of cooperation or forward motion. You might see a relationship more objectively, or your attention may be more balanced between your own plans and your relationships, which benefits you. You may get a subtle boost in your social or romantic life, or friends may bring good news or advice. You can quite enjoy latching onto a special heartfelt pursuit. Your sense of timing is good today, and plans may come together in rewarding ways.

Today's transits are quite suitable for taking care of business, dear Pisces. Decisions surrounding business and other practical matters tend to be sound. Energies now are also strong for some gentle ambition, as you’re inclined to appreciate the finer things in life, and putting in the effort toward securing your future in some way can be satisfying. Anything that brings better function to your daily routine, habits, and work holds special appeal today. Intuition is strong for business and practical affairs, and you have a stronger sense of your duties and others’ expectations. Fortunately, you can feel quite comfortable with your responsibilities right now, putting you in a perfect space for productivity. You're also more aware of how your reputation affects your life, and ideas for improvement are at the ready.
